subject: Air freight quote to PEK
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote your cheapest air freight option to PEK (Beijing, CN) for 5 pieces of furniture samples? The gross weight is 1953 kg and the total volume is 4.91 cbm.

The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-28 at our site, postcode 47941 (Duisburg), Germany. Please arrange the truck to the departure airport and include this in your all-in price in EUR.

Please attach your offer as a PDF to your reply, as our purchasing department needs it for filing.

Thank you.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new all-in air freight quote for a specified shipment to PEK.
